prompt: A repo credential scoped to write a given repository is rejected when the same credential is used to resolve or read that repository, forcing clients to mint a second, separately-scoped credential just to read before they write. This turns a single write workflow into two credential round-trips. Make a write-capable credential also satisfy read operations on the same repository, while a read-only credential still cannot write. Keep the fix minimal.
